features.qualification: Create/edit and name/room filtering; no general item-delete action advertised.
Supported intent patterns read saved fields directly; not automatic extraction from uploaded identity documents.
Reports the recorded full path; physical movement is not detected; alias/intent matching is bounded.
Home, room, zone, optional container; photo association; paths included in chunk text/metadata.
Data-driven geometry, screen labels with collision hiding, cutaway walls, room transition, controls, selected-path pulse, breadcrumb navigation; no measured FPS claim.
Grid snapping, rooms/furniture, resize/rotate, numeric controls, doors/windows, attached-space flag.
Furnished rooms and labeled synthetic sources; ordinary retrieval excludes samples unless requested.
Immutable originals, async state, leased retries, active evidence generation; new versions do not establish duplicate-content deduplication.
Authenticated page/region/row/time evidence and original access; browser/media behavior requires its own live verification.
PDF, UTF-8 TXT/CSV, XLSX/XLSM values, Pillow-decodable rasters, FFmpeg-decodable media; no legacy XLS, arbitrary Office formats, executed macros/formulas, or universal codec promise.
Parallel dense/word/fuzzy, weighted RRF, location boost, candidate shortlists; cross-encoder optional and disabled by default.
NFKC/lowercase/punctuation, runs longer than two reduced, aliases, n-grams/edit matching and advisory low-score suggestions; not every typo guaranteed.
Photo attachment, browser microphone note, voice transcription, auxiliary SigLIP2 retrieval; media cache bypass; image queries bypass direct saved-record match.
Local Qwen draft/reviewer, exact quoted spans, source/version validation, supporting pages, safe heading/table display; synthesized visual/text claims can still be wrong.
Private saved searches/answers, canonical citations/current location references; optional editor item-history attachment.
Household+user/version/config/scope keys, exact/semantic guards, reference validation, TTL/LRU, bypass, owner metrics/clear API; private answer/query content is retained intentionally.

features.status: Known defect; not advertised as working
features.qualification: UI helper sends POST with {method: DELETE} as JSON instead of HTTP DELETE; reported to orchestrator for the sole fixer after baseline.
Verified email/password, reset, passkeys, TOTP/recovery codes, active sessions, revoke other sessions, logout; production requires SMTP/HTTPS and device-specific testing.
Multiple-household selection, owner/editor/viewer, email-bound invitations, member updates/removal, last-owner protection; application checks, not database RLS.
In-app one-time/recurring tasks, calendar, completion and activity; no unattended maintenance emails.
Monthly allowance, atomic reservation/charge/refund, idempotence, ledger and CSV; no payment provider.
Job/worker/usage/audit views, JSON export omitting storage/vector fields, confirmed deletion; originals separate.
Light/dark, responsive navigation, reduced motion, WebGL unavailable/lost fallback; not a measured universal-accessibility claim.
Private immutable files, authorized byte ranges, PostgreSQL leased queue; no active object-storage/Redis integration.
Confidence is categorical. AUROC/Brier/ECE cannot be claimed without numeric scores and labeled outcomes.
A fresh conversation is created for each ask; saved messages are not supplied as query history.
No dedicated table structure model, figure detector, caption model, or chart parser; OCR/page-image interpretation is distinct.
Persistent private files/DB and long-running model/worker processes required; Vercel alone does not host the complete included stack.
Setup admits Python 3.10 but hashlib.file_digest requires 3.11+. Reported to orchestrator; README recommends 3.12 until fixed/tested.
